3 · MODEL SERVICE (HTTP /predict)
transformer, sequence (1, 512, 458)
→ embedding 1024, centre id, similarity

group by centre id
(ids 1117–1137 above 9 GHz → 1117)

medoid refresh per id
(keep the better of old medoid / new medoid)

refined similarity ≥ 0.7
(0.5 for 1117)
and id in library list?

known emitter (name = id)
first time: emitter + signal if > 20 pulses
later: extend signal, update bearing

6 · WRITE per window
cluster rows + stats, CH pulse ids
(PG commit every 32 windows)
keep last 200 s of the buffer

greedy clustering
leader + all free pulses with cosine ≥ 0.8
≥ 20 members, beam score > 0.3

merge clusters
0.8·cos(mean vectors) + 0.2·angle score > 0.7
connected components (BFS)

match unknown track cache
0.8·cos(medoid, track) + 0.2·cos² bearing > 0.5

end of file: flush CH rows,
de-harmonize cluster PRI
